_comment: Human-set guardrail: the ONLY TrainingConfig fields an automated agent may vary, and the closed numeric range it may vary them within. ExperimentConfigGenerator.generate_variant() raises UnapprovedConfigOverrideError for any field not listed here, or any value outside its range. Copy this file, adjust the ranges for your own risk tolerance, and point --allowed-ranges at your copy - do not edit this example file for a real project, it is checked in as documentation of the mechanism.
